clauses.label: section 301
clauses.text:
section 301 of T itle 3 of the United States Code, it is hereby ordered as 
follow s:

clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. The Secretary  of D efense is designated N ational D efense Stockpile 
M anager. The functions vested in the President by the Strategic and Critical 
M aterials Stock Piling A ct, excep t the functions vested in the President by 
sections 7, 8, and 13 of the A ct, are delegated to the Secretary of D efense. The 
functions vested in the President by section 8(a) of the A ct are delegated to 
the Secretary of the Interior. The functions vested in the President by section 
8(b) of the A ct are delegated to the Secretary  of Agriculture.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. The functions vested in the President by section 4(h) of the Commodity 
Credit Corporation C harter A ct, as am ended (15 U.S.C. 714b(h)), are delegated 
to the Secretary of D efense.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. The functions vested in the President by section 204(f) of the Federal 
Property and A dm inistrative Services A ct of 1949, as am ended (40 U.S.C. 
485(f)), are delegated to the Secretary  of D efense.

clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text:
Sec. 4. In executing the functions delegated to him by this Order, the Secretary 
of D efense may delegate such functions as he may deem appropriate, subject 
to his direction. The Secretary  shall consult with the heads of affected 
agencies in performing the functions delegated to him by this Order.
TH E W H ITE HOUSE, 
F e b r u a r y  25, 1988.
